clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt works to find a cure for the leper gnomes of Gnomeregan. He and Razzle Sprysprocket continue their research among the snowy hills of Dun Morogh.

Ozzie Togglevolt was deep inside Gnomeregan when catastrophe struck. As toxic fallout filled the corridors to stem the trogg invasion, he stood beside Gnoarn. A sudden radioactive discharge hit Gnoarn, changing him forever before Ozzie's eyes. Ozzie escaped to the surface and reached Dun Morogh alive, but the disaster stayed with him.

In Kharanos, Ozzie spends his days tinkering with Razzle Sprysprocket. Their work is personal: they seek a way to reverse the mutagenic fallout from their lost home and cure the suffering leper gnomes.

related.n: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
